children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may extend loss into a range of 4,316-4,332 ringgit per metric ton, as suggested by a channel technique and a projection analysis.

The contract has fallen to 4,357 ringgit, the 438.2% projection level of a downtrend from 4,833 ringgit. The lower channel, which was duplicated from the upper channel, suggests a  further fall to the 476.4% level of 4,316 ringgit.
Resistance is at 4,399 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain into the 4,424-4,440 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the contract has briefly pierced below a support at 4,368 ringgit.
The big black candle during the previous session indicates a break below this support. The next support will be at 4,292 ringgit, a break below which could trigger a further drop to 4,210 ringgit.
